> This message is automatically generated by a bot.
Do you have a minimal reproducer?

Hm, I think that it might be connected to the fact that as of 2.3 we [remove the _unused_ interceptors](https://quarkus.io/guides/cdi-reference#remove_unused_beans) from the app. And given the fact that interceptors bound to a rest client interface represent a non-standard way of interceptor association it's very likely that this optimization is the cause of this problem.

You can try to disable this optimization completely via `quarkus.arc.remove-unused-beans=false`. A workaround is to list the interceptor classes in the `quarkus.arc.unremovable-types` property.

The correct solution would be to detect the interceptors associated with all rest client interfaces and make them unremovable via the `UnremovableBeanBuildItem`.

issue.title: RESTEasy classic rest client - make associated interceptors unremovable
